title: test(rest): the §6 leak check in rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts matches /TypeError|boom/ against the whole response, so an import job id that happens to spell "boom" turns main red (schedule run 40136758584)
body:
Filing gate ①: main red, reproduced in the hourly full battery. Filed by the triage seat (seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:server` seat that owns `packages/rest`. One test-only PR, S.

## Measured

- `CI` schedule run 40136758584, job `Test Core (6/6)` (120999879953):
  ```
  FAIL src/rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts:707:38
  [#22764] §6 every driven write row answers a sandboxed fault as the doors do, its words withheld > POST /api/v1/data/:object/import/jobs: a body that CRASHED
  AssertionError: expected '{"jobId":"imp_mvmy7boom9kp06vk","obje…' not to match /TypeError|boom/
  ```
- **No error text leaked.** The import job id is `imp_${Date.now().toString(36)}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}` (`rest-server.ts:946`). The timestamp part `mvmy7boo` (22:06:07.080Z) plus a random `m` spells "boom". The regex is matched against `JSON.stringify(res.body)`.
- None of the three commits since the previous green run touch `packages/rest`. The push run on the same commit passed live (759.96 s). The test file last changed in `adb7910f81`.

## Wanted

The leak check uses a sentinel that cannot occur by chance in a generated id or timestamp. For example, the injected fault throws a long unique marker (`__OS_SANDBOX_FAULT_7f3a9c__`) and the assertion looks for that. Or it asserts only on the fields that carry words (`error`, `message`, `details`), not on the whole body. Apply the same fix to any other row of the ledger that uses the same short sentinel. ⛔ No retry and no skip: the check stays exactly as strict.

## Acceptance

- The ledger test passes, and an ablation where the fault's words *do* reach the body still fails it.
- `git grep -n "/TypeError|boom/" packages/rest/src` shows no whole-body match on a short sentinel.
